page.layout: One printed page, one column of running text. Running head at the top, page number at the top left. No marginal notes. Two Hebrew lines set inside the text, after "inquit,". A small mark with a box at the lower left, below the last line.

main_text.p: & aliis librum R. Aser accuratissime multis vicibus ab eo correctū, Hierosolymis à multis annis, ut inde libri corrigerentur expositum; & inquit, נעלי לממכת בְּמִפִּי הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁכָּתַבְתִּי כְּהֲלָכָתוֹ alius erat Hierosolymis, vel forte idem liber Hierosolymitanus, quem antiquissimus Grammaticus R. Jonam sequebatur, ut de eo testantur Kimhi & Elias Levita. Erat in Hispania celeberrimus dictus Hillelianus, de quo Elias. Et habemus hic an-tiqua Manuscripta Biblia quaedam, qua-dringentorum annorum, in quibus ad marginem saepe citatur; aliis in locis alii fuerunt; testatur Kimhi in proœmio in radices, magnam se invenisse confusionem in punctationibus librorum regionis, in qua vivebat; eam autem in Dictionario suo & Grammatica correxisse, ope librorum correctorum ex Hispania adductorum, atque in hoc nationi suae magnum operae, pretium fecisse. In Europa autem libri Hispanici primas tulerunt, testatur Elias Levita in fractorum tabulis, & ita quoque censet R. Menacham,

page.notes: The first Hebrew line ("נעלי לממכת") and the second line ("במפי ההורה שכתבתי כהלכהו", printed without niqqud) are doubtful at several letters; I have copied them as best I can read and they are not checked against a source. The second line is printed with the last word "כהלכהו" and I read the letters from the scan as shown. "correctū" has a macron that may be a printing mark. The line ends "Menacham" with a dash-like mark before the comma; it is read as a line-end dash. The mark at the lower left (a Hebrew letter with a box) is a printed reference mark or signature-like device and is not transcribed as text. "Erat in Hispania" is printed "Erat inHispania" with no space; I have read it as two words. "Elias Levita" is printed "EliasLevita" in the last line and is read as two words.
